before.revision: a27d8e9 plus worker snapshot and socket-overflow observability

a4c6a7d.description: Bounded RX, pressure tail progress, frame-aligned GSO, RX pool reserve; 128-record budget and origin-based owners

prefix_copy.revision: ec2939b plus contiguous reassembly copy; timer change excluded

timers_counters.revision: a86da73 plus counter publication once per millisecond or 256 turns

queues.revision: a86da73 plus counter publication and socket-buffer setup

steering.revision: e8dbd41 plus ordered receive groups and cookie/lane reuseport steering

tap_wait.revision: 5c3bb1c plus TAP read-interest gating by available TX buffers

profile.placement: CPUs 0-19 on socket 0; 20-23 on socket 1; shared local machine, no exclusive CPU reservation
profile.generator: Two concurrent unidirectional client/server pairs, UDP, fixed source ports 51000 onward; fresh iperf processes each point; same daemons and namespaces throughout each sweep
profile.outer: IPv6 UDP loopback; 1232-byte UDP ceiling, GSO/GRO; no injected impairment
profile.inner: IPv4 UDP through two TAPs in separate network namespaces; inner MTU 1500, DF; no direct inner path
profile.transport: 4 workers, 4 TAP queues, 4 transmit lanes per daemon; 1 session per daemon

units.bitrate_per_flow: iperf -b requested per flow per direction; 0 means unlimited
units.generator_cpu_percent: local sender + local receiver; 100% is one core
units.cpu_ticks: Ordered CPU indices from zero through array length minus one; eight fields as listed. Primary profile has 24 CPUs; one_socket_20 has 20. Includes unrelated shared-machine activity.
units.transport: worker counter deltas summed per endpoint; gauge deltas are not event counts
units.socket_overflow: SO_RXQ_OVFL kernel SKBs, not GRO-expanded logical datagrams
units.admission_pressure: packets not fully admitted after drain/retry
units.expired_frames: combined sender/receiver frame expiry events; not a disjoint count of missing inner frames

sampling_profile.limitations: Includes startup/shutdown; sampling overhead and scheduling can bias short stages. tap_cpu_ns is a subset of stages 1 and 3, not additional CPU.

one_socket_20.placement: All 20 CPUs on socket 0; receiver sets reduced from four CPUs to two; same binary and transport configuration; new outer sockets
